articles.title: Joe Ryan’s return to rotation is promising, but Twins lose to Tigers in Labor Day matinee
articles.description: Joe Ryan returns to the mound after a month on the injured list, with the Twins 4½ games out of the final AL wild-card spot. Follow the score, highlights and analysis from Detroit.

articles.title: Nine years after the Twins’ historic turnaround, the White Sox are closing in on an unprecedented feat
articles.description: The 2017 Twins were the first MLB team to make the playoffs after a 100-loss season. Now, the White Sox are on the verge of going one step further by winning the AL Central.

articles.title: Twins’ playoff hopes take another hit in nationally televised blowout loss to White Sox
articles.description: The Twins enter tonight 3½ games out of the final AL wild-card spot with 20 to play. Bailey Ober starts in the prime-time rubber match on Peacock and NBC Sports Network.

articles.title: Reusse: Twins fans have waited years for a leadoff hitter like Luke Keaschall. He’s worth embracing.
articles.description: Keaschall has the speed, power and patience the Twins have long coveted atop their lineup. And the 24-year-old former wrestler brings some old-school toughness, too.

articles.title: The Twins’ playoff hopes are slipping away. Can they fix their road woes before it’s too late?
articles.description: The Twins are three games out of the final AL wild-card spot with 22 to play. A six-game road trip through Chicago and Detroit could reshape their postseason chances.

articles.title: Ryan Jeffers keeps the Twins’ playoff hopes afloat with a timely home run
articles.description: The Twins’ odds of making the playoffs are down to 4% as they play the AL Central-leading White Sox tonight in Chicago.

articles.title: Twins playoff odds plummet as road trip gets off to dispiriting start in Chicago
articles.description: Zebby Matthews, who has won five consecutive starts, takes the mound as the Twins enter tonight three games out of the final AL wild-card spot with 22 games remaining.

articles.title: Byron Buxton needs hip surgery, but the Twins All-Star hopes to return for playoff push
articles.description: Buxton knows he’ll need surgery after months of battling hip pain, but he isn’t ready to shut down his season while the Twins remain alive in the playoff race.

articles.title: Twins’ Walker Jenkins and Tigers’ Max Clark can’t escape the comparisons. Now they’re MLB rivals.
articles.description: Jenkins and Clark were picked two spots apart in the 2023 MLB draft. Three years later, their parallel paths have brought them to the majors at almost the same time.

articles.title: Twins miss golden opportunities to gain ground in playoff push, fall to Tigers in 12 innings
articles.description: The Twins have outscored the Tigers 26-3 in the first two games at Target Field but haven’t made much of a dent in the AL playoff race.

articles.title: Twins make no decision on injured Buxton as they head home after loss to A’s
articles.description: The A’s rallied to a 7-4 victory on Wednesday as the Twins played without Buxton. Top prospect Walker Jenkins waits in the wings.

articles.title: Reusse: Walker Jenkins gives the Twins reason to dream big. Joe Mauer big.
articles.description: The 21-year-old top prospect finally made his long-awaited MLB debut. The expectations are enormous, but the possibilities might be, too.
